name: Flavian
slug: Uncertain name for a woman recalled as the party's tavern manager.
description: Flavian is the uncertain name the DM attaches to a woman on the staff of the party's tavern, recalled as the bar manager.

log.summary: During the drinking night, the DM named a woman on the tavern staff Flavian without being sure of the name, and recalled her as the bar manager. As owners, the party was not asked to pay.
notes: Name the DM attaches, without certainty, to a woman on the tavern staff during the drinking night. Recalled as the bar manager. The party was not asked to pay as owners.
